newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai c. bank intervenes to stop baht fall-dealers.
newsitem.headline: Thai c. bank intervenes to stop baht fall-dealers.

text.p: The Bank of Thailand on Monday intervened in the domestic market and sold dollars at the 30.75-30.80 per dollar level to try to prevent the baht from falling further against the U.S. unit, dealers said.

The baht was quoted at new record low of around 30.30/30.75 per dollar early in the domestic market compared with 30.00/30.60 late on Friday. The baht dived on commercial selling for dollars and on hangover from the Philippine peso slide.
"The central bank intervened through a small local bank by selling the dollar at around 30.75-30.80," said one dealer at a European bank.
